dimensions.assessment: Affects elderly Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries eligible for PACE, PACE provider organizations, and state Medicaid agencies.
dimensions.evidence: a PACE program eligible individual may enroll in a PACE program at any time during a month.

dimensions.assessment: Removes administrative and numerical enrollment barriers, permits anytime enrollment, and mandates that all states offer PACE services after a compliance period.
dimensions.evidence: on and after such compliance date with respect to the State, the State shall provide... medical assistance with respect to PACE program services

dimensions.assessment: Requires state Medicaid programs to fund PACE program services and requires capitation payments to be prorated for mid-month enrollments, with unknown net fiscal totals.
dimensions.evidence: the capitation amount that would otherwise be made under this subsection to the PACE provider for such individual for the first month in which such individual is so enrolled shall be prorated accordingly.

dimensions.assessment: Amends Titles XVIII and XIX of the Social Security Act, altering Medicare and Medicaid program rules, state plan requirements, and federal regulatory procedures.
dimensions.evidence: To amend titles XVIII and XIX of the Social Security Act to improve access to the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), to reduce regulatory burdens on PACE providers

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory changes taking effect starting January 1, 2027, with mandatory state compliance deadlines ranging from 180 days to 3 years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Beginning January 1, 2027, the following shall apply... With respect to enrollments made on or after January 1, 2027

importance_detail.rationale: Improves access to the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) by allowing anytime enrollment with prorated payments, streamlining application and site expansion processes, and requiring states to offer PACE program services.
